title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
text: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
text: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.
